scope: Computer Control Phase 9D1A physical validation of the public global read-only display.list contract on macOS

independentOracle.mechanism: independent AppKit NSScreen plus CoreGraphics observation

expectedCoverage: all structure and contract guards pass with Phase 9D1A implemented and Phase 9D discovery preserved as historical provenance
runtime.info reports display.list as IMPLEMENTED with os-owned-native-display-observation strategy
at least one native display is observed and exactly one is primary
public display count and canonical semantic vector exactly match the independent native oracle
logical bounds, usable bounds, scale, rotation, primary, built-in, active and online state are exposed
CGDirectDisplayID, NSScreenNumber and native pixel-dimension claims do not cross the public boundary
repeated public observation is stable while topology is unchanged
observation performs no display mutation, screenshot, keyboard, mouse, clipboard or AppleScript operation
